about: S21 frame budget on WJ's laptop (Ryzen 5 5500U, Vega 7, Edge, 60 Hz panel), checked by `npm run perf:budget` (tools/perf/frameprof.ts --budget). Per run (a 12 s AI fight or one Ultimate): rAF frame intervals and the main thread's CPU per rendered frame. A missed vsync is an interval over 20 ms (any cause: the OS and the browser's compositor hitch now and then, so up to 2 a run pass); the max-frame limit applies when our own frame CPU went over it too. Judder = rendered frames that ran 2+ sim ticks (a skipped and then doubled tick; 0-tick frames are the sim's slow motion).

known.reason: one 50 ms frame at the KO → next round reset (a hard cut): the colossus's nextRound, ≈ 36 ms in Node, ≈ 50 ms in Edge. Measured 2026-10-14 (.scratch/healspike.ts): world.heal of its 19 bodies (the eye 65×65 and 18 rig regions up to 134×101) ≈ 20 ms, and the behaviour reset ≈ 13 ms, mostly re-creating severed regions with a full createBody/initBody. Partly cold code: the second match in a page costs ≈ 18 ms, and a warm, heavily damaged colossus 9–13 ms. Rehearsing round changes in src/app/rehearsal.ts does not help, because its bodies are barely damaged and it never reaches those paths. Sim work at a round transition, not render.
